description: Header file defining the socket_adaptor class for managing UNIX domain socket connections, including methods for connecting, listening, data transfer, and callback registration.

classes.name: socket_adaptor
classes.description: Class managing UNIX domain socket connections with methods for connection, listening, data transfer, and callback registration.

methods.name: connect_socket
methods.description: Connects to a specified socket path for reading data.

methods.name: start_listening
methods.description: Sets up the adaptor to listen for incoming UNIX domain socket connections on a specified path.

methods.name: get_path
methods.description: Returns the data path of the UNIX domain socket.

methods.name: fetch_data
methods.description: Reads all available data from the socket into an internal buffer.

methods.name: get_active_connections
methods.description: Returns the number of active socket connections.

methods.name: register_data_ready_callback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be invoked when data is ready.
